relations.subject: Manfred Mayrhofer
relations.evidence: studied Indo-European and Semitic linguistics and philosophy at the University of Graz, where he received his Ph.D. in 1949.

relations.subject: Manfred Mayrhofer
relations.evidence: From 1953 to 1963 he taught at the University of Würzburg

relations.subject: Manfred Mayrhofer
relations.evidence: from 1963 to 1966 he was a professor at Saarland University.

relations.subject: Manfred Mayrhofer
relations.evidence: In 1966 he returned to Austria, serving as professor at the University of Vienna until his retirement in 1990.
